{{Quote|Hey there! I'm a field producer for the HoloNet program "Wild, Wild Galaxy" back on Coruscant. We're doing a short segment on the local Periodic Overland Migration for next season, and we want recordings of groups of seasoned hunters defending settlements. You know, "Heroically they drive back the onslaught of predators drawn by the scent of sentient blood!" We've located a very attractive pack at these coordinates, and our hovercams will be viewing you remotely at telescopic range. Great, looking forward to working with you.|[[Morn Meebler]]|<ref name="SWG:HSoOM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||HoloNet Show on Overland Migration}}</ref>}}
'''''Wild, Wild Galaxy''''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] program produced by the [[HoloNet Broadcasting Service]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It featured wild creatures from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the producers of ''Wild, Wild Galaxy'' hired seasoned hunters to fight vicious animals and filmed these encounters by remote-controlled [[Cam droid/Legends|hovercams]]. One of the show's field producers was [[Morn Meebler]].<ref name="SWG:HSoOM" />
